auth.invitationSignInDescription: Sign in with the invited address to continue joining this Organization.
auth.invitationDescription: Create your personal login with the invited address. Verify your email, then accept the invitation to join.
auth.signInDescription: Sign in to continue managing Project travel costs.
auth.partnerDescription: Create your personal login with the address that received the setup link. Then continue your Partner Organization setup.
auth.directDescription: Create your personal login, verify your email, then set up your Organization to host Erasmus Projects.
auth.name: Name
auth.invitationPointer: Joining an existing Organization? Open the link in your invitation email instead.
auth.metadata: Sign in or create a personal login for Greendex Cost Tracker.

confirmSignOut.title: Sign out?
confirmSignOut.description: Sign out of Cost Tracker? You can sign in again at any time.

invitation.heading: Join your Organization
invitation.creationBlocked: You cannot create an Organization while you have a pending invitation to {organization}. Join this Organization or reject its invitation below. Other invitations or an existing Membership may still prevent creation.
invitation.rejected: You rejected the invitation to {organization}. Your current access has been checked again. Follow the next step below.
invitation.options: Join this Organization or reject its invitation below. Pending colleague invitations prevent creating a new Organization. Rejection removes only this invitation, not other invitations or existing Memberships.

confirmReject.title: Reject Organization Invitation?
confirmReject.description: Reject the invitation to join {organization}? You will need a new invitation to join later.

inbox.heading: Check your inbox
inbox.invitationInstruction: Verify your email first. Then review the invitation to join the Organization or reject it. If the message does not arrive, send a new link below.
inbox.instruction: Open the link to verify your personal login and continue where you left off in Cost Tracker.
inbox.spam: If the message is not visible, check your spam folder too.
inbox.signIn: Already verified or already have an account? Sign in to continue this invitation.

resend.label: Send a new verification link
resend.success: Request received. If your account still needs verification, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
resend.error: Could not request a new link. Please try again shortly.

recovery.title: Return to your invitation
recovery.wrongEmail: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Continue with the address that received it.
recovery.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your Organization for a new invitation.
recovery.closed: This invitation is no longer available. Ask your Organization for a new invitation.
recovery.unavailable: We cannot use this invitation. Open the complete link from your invitation email, or ask your Organization for a new invitation.
recovery.recheck: After correcting your login or receiving a new link, open that invitation. You can also check this invitation again.
recovery.rejected: This invitation was rejected. Check your current access below to resolve any other invitation or continue with your Organization.
recovery.withdrawn: The inviting Organization withdrew this invitation. Check your current access below for the next step.
recovery.accepted: This invitation was accepted. Check your Organization access below. If access was removed, ask its Owner for help.

selection.heading: Select an Organization
selection.description: Choose which Organization to continue with. This changes your active Organization, not your Memberships or Project Participations.
selection.error: Could not select that Organization. Check your access and try again.

error.request: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
error.credentials: Incorrect email or password. Check your details and try again.
error.verification: Verify your email before signing in. Open the verification link in your inbox.
